spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता or -नी-तं)
White, of a white colour.
m. (-तः)
White, (the colour.)
E.
श्यै to go, Uṇādi aff. इतच्.

m. (-कः)
A sort of fish, (Cyprinus sophore, HAM.)

m. (-नः)
1 A hawk, a falcon.
2 White, (the colour.)
3 Whiteness, paleness.
4 Violence, desperation.
f. (-नी)
1 The female hawk.
2 A species of the Triṣṭubh metre.
E.
श्यै to go, इञ् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Acting rashly or desperately.
2 Burning on a separate funeral pile.
E.
श्येन, and करण acting; also श्येनकरणिका.

m. (-चित्)
1 A hawk feeder or keeper.
2 A receptacle shaped like a hawk for a sacrificial fire.
E.
श्येन a hawk, and चित् what collects.

m. (-वी)
One who sells hawks or lives by training them.
E.
श्येन, and जीविन् living.

m. (-शः)
Recommendation or injunction to women, to burn on a separate funeral pile.
E.
श्येन violence, and उपदेश advice.
